extracted text: The paper investigates the mechanical properties of aluminum alloy 6016 processed by equal channel angular pressing (ECAP) with and without back pressure. The material was tested in the O temper (annealed condition). Processing was done with 0 MPa and 200 MPa back pressure for different numbers of ECAP passes (1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16). Testing was performed at room temperature and elevated temperatures (up to 300°C). A maximum ductility of ~100% was obtained at 200°C and strain rate of 10^-4 s^-1, which is better than the ~89% ductility exhibited by AA6016 after conventional thermomechanical treatment at 500°C.
